edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender to owner, establishing the privileged account.
attack verifies msg.sender equals the hero owner before state changes and refunds.
revive uses msg.sender for refunds while resetting arbitrary hero IDs.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferring ownership.
pause is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender.
unpause is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender.
destroy is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender.
destroyAndSend is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender.
setEdCoreContract is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender.
setEntranceFee is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender.
setReviveFee is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender.
getRunDetails derives run state from now, making output dependent on timestamp.
attack uses now to stamp monster creation time and decide whether the run ended.
_attack compares now with monster creation time and flee window to decide monster fleeing and damage.
Randomness mixes block.number/hash derived from time-advancing chain state.
Ownable constructor writes owner.
transferOwnership writes owner after checking onlyOwner.
pause sets paused = true.
unpause sets paused = false.

attack initialises heroIdToHealth with the hero initial health.
attack increases heroIdToRefundedFee by addToJackpot.
attack adds addToJackpot to the jackpot.
revive adds reviveFee to the jackpot.
revive deletes heroIdToMonster for the hero.
revive deletes heroIdToHealth for the hero.
revive deletes heroIdToRefundedFee for the hero.
Owner-only setter overwrites the external core contract address.
Owner-only setter overwrites the entrance fee.
Owner-only setter overwrites the revive fee.

_attack decrements heroIdToHealth by damageByMonster or zeroes it on defeat.
_attack increases heroIdToRefundedFee by rewards and addToJackpot.
_attack subtracts rewards from and adds addToJackpot to the jackpot.
_attack decrements entranceFeePool by rewards and addToJackpot.

revive reads reviveFee for the payment requirement and refund computation.

getRunDetails exposes the revive fee setting.

_attack compares now against creationTime + monsterFleeTime.
getRunDetails reads heroIdToHealth to report the hero health.
getRunDetails reads heroIdToMonster for the current monster state.
attack calls the internal _attack once pre-conditions hold and the run has not ended.

attack refunds all value sent for non-start attacks to msg.sender.
_attack pays rewards to msg.sender in the middle of state updates.

destroyAndSend invokes selfdestruct(_recipient) with an arbitrary recipient.
